name: Cloudial Advanced Table
description: A reusable config-driven Lightning datatable with custom cell types, CRM chrome (search/filter/columns/bulk), client-side sort, validation hooks, and visual themes.
features: Config-driven columns (Cloudial schema or raw lightning-datatable columns)
Custom cell types: combobox, pencilEditable, booleanCheckbox, scoreMeter, booleanBadge, action menu, status icons
Header actions, contextual bulk-actions, toolbar slot
Optional search, filter panel, column picker, refresh chrome
Declarative validation plus host error map
Themes: default, dense, glass, soft, highContrast
Nested LWC only (Lightning Web Security required cross-namespace)
whenToUse: Use when a Salesforce LWC needs a generic, themeable data grid with richer cell editing and CRM-style chrome than base lightning-datatable, without host-app hardwiring.
